Section: Bounded sleep loss and caffeine evidence
Exact_Text: Acute caffeine partially mitigated selected sleep-loss vigilance, cognition and military-task decrements in the reviewed military trials; this does not resolve sleep loss or establish benefit for every task.
Transferability: International military context; Brazil applicability requires separate contextual validation.
